caption: The drawing features two line illustrations of a long-sleeved shirt rendered in fine, precise pencil lines on a plain, off-white background. The main, larger shirt is positioned centrally and depicted from the front, showing a pointed collar, a vertical band of ruffles running down one side of the chest from the collar to mid-torso, a buttoned placket, and cuffs at the end of each sleeve. The shirt is long and straight in cut, with visible side gussets and button details at the sleeve cuffs. In the upper right portion of the drawing, there is a smaller, secondary illustration of the same shirt shown from the back, with arms extended horizontally and without visible decorative details. The lines are clean, and the drawing is free of shading or color fill, with the only color present being the natural beige tone of the paper. There are some small, faint marks or stains near the smaller shirt in the upper right.
title: Man's Shirt
